messages:
chloe: heads up — promo for v2.14.0 is blocked, canary failed during CI. cache-validate step returning 503s and then artifact fetches timeout. release window in ~2h :alarm_clock:

deploy-bot: automatic rollback prevented: promo_state=HALTED, last_error="artifact fetch failed (404) after cache validate error". retry_count=3

jon: logs?

chloe: pasted last snippet: 
```
cache-validate: GET https://cache.internal/validate/sha256:abc123 -> 503
fetch-artifact: GET https://registry.internal/artifacts/v2.14.0/layer-3.tar.gz -> 404
```

maya: 503 from cache usually means edge/proxy or auth token expired. 404 for artifact suggests upload never finished or index mismatch. are we sure the build uploaded successfully?

sre-oncall: we're seeing elevated 5xx from cache cluster in us-west-2 since 10m ago. ops alerted, rotating caches now.

chloe: build step logs show successful upload step exited 0, but upload checksum doesn't match index entry. maybe a race with promotion job?

jon: can we manually pin to last-good artifact and run canary smoke? cc @release-manager

release-manager: proposal: hold promo, pin route to v2.13.7 for production, then investigate. If we want to unblock now, do a manual promote of previously verified image. We lose release window but keep stability.

maya: agree with pin. quick checks: `gsutil ls gs://artifacts/prod/v2.13.7/` -> exists. Also run smoke suite locally against pinned artifact before manual promote.

chloe: manual promote steps?

jon: 1) create PR to update release pin -> infra/rollout/manifest#xxxx
2) trigger deploy-bot manual-promo with `@deploy-bot promote --manifest infra/rollout/manifest#xxxx --force --reason \"canary artifact fetch failures\"`
3) run smoke: `make smoke-canary` (10m)

deploy-bot: acknowledge. promote command requires approval from release-manager and +1 from eng-release lead. Will not run until approved.

release-manager: approved. jon please hold the PR and ping me when smoke passes.

sre-oncall: ops ETA to restore cache cluster ~30-45m, but intermittent 503s may persist. Recommend pinning to unblock customers.

chloe: ok. jon/maya run smoke asap. also open an incident ticket referencing cache cluster and artifact index mismatch.

jon: running smoke now. will report back in thread. :eyes:

(10m later)

jon: smoke passed against v2.13.7 canary. no regressions. prepared PR at infra/rollout/manifest#4572.

release-manager: approving manual promote. deploy-bot pls proceed once I +1 in PR.

deploy-bot: manual promote initiated by release-manager. promoting infra/rollout/manifest#4572 -> prod. sending notifications.

chloe: updating release notes: add note that v2.14.0 delayed due to artifact index race/cache outage; will include root cause once triaged.

maya: opening follow-up: if cache auth token rotation can cause transient 503s, we should add retry/backoff and pre-validate uploads before marking success. filing a small infra task.

release-manager: decision: postpone v2.14.0 to next change window, mark as blocked in release tracker, and coordinate postmortem. good call on pinning to v2.13.7 to preserve SLA. :thumbsup:

chloe: thanks all. will update customer-facing notes and send a short status mail.

jon: thanks — closing thread once deploy-bot confirms prod healthy.

deploy-bot: promote complete. prod rollout at 25% -> 100% over 12m, no errors. final status: SUCCESS.

chloe: prod confirmed healthy. closing and filing follow-ups.
